Bash(powershell.exe -Command "
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

function TextToImage\(\\$text, \\$outputPath\) {
    \\$font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font\('Consolas', 11\)
    \\$brush = [System.Drawing.Brushes]::White
    \\$bgBrush = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush\([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb\(30, 30, 30\)\)
    \\$greenBrush = New-Object System.Drawing.SolidBrush\([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb\(80, 200, 80\)\)
    
    \\$lines = \\$text -split [Environment]::NewLine
    \\$lineHeight = 18
    \\$width = 900
    \\$height = \(\\$lines.Count + 2\) * \\$lineHeight + 40
    
    \\$bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap\(\\$width, \\$height\)
    \\$g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage\(\\$bmp\)
    \\$g.FillRectangle\(\\$bgBrush, 0, 0, \\$width, \\$height\)
    
    \\$y = 20
    foreach \(\\$line in \\$lines\) {
        if \(\\$line -match 'PASS|SUCCESS'\) {
            \\$g.DrawString\(\\$line, \\$font, \\$greenBrush, 20, \\$y\)
        } else {
            \\$g.DrawString\(\\$line, \\$font, \\$brush, 20, \\$y\)
        }
        \\$y += \\$lineHeight
    }
    
    \\$g.Dispose\(\)
    \\$bmp.Save\(\\$outputPath, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png\)
    \\$bmp.Dispose\(\)
}

\\$report = Get-Content 'D:\\a-joii\\project\\srm-ai\\ai-code\\srm-ai-dev\\appsmith-ai-ide\\test-img\\test-report.txt' -Raw
TextToImage \\$report 'D:\\a-joii\\project\\srm-ai\\ai-code\\srm-ai-dev\\appsmith-ai-ide\\test-img\\test-report.png'

\\$summary = Get-Content 'D:\\a-joii\\project\\srm-ai\\ai-code\\srm-ai-dev\\appsmith-ai-ide\\test-img\\test-summary.txt' -Raw
TextToImage \\$summary 'D:\\a-joii\\project\\srm-ai\\ai-code\\srm-ai-dev\\appsmith-ai-ide\\test-img\\test-summary.png'

Write-Output 'Screenshots saved'
" 2>&1)
